summary: fix(wework): declare the MCPB bearer-token environment contract
reason: The MCP server accepts WEWORK_TOKEN, so the packaged MCPB manifest must map that variable to a sensitive required user-config field. Without the mapping, public-library manifest validation rejects the package and MCPB hosts cannot provision the token.
validated_outcome: The public-library MCPB manifest verifier accepts the package and the declared token remains a sensitive user-config value rather than embedded data.
